<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Cui''' is one of Frieza's henchmen and the first boss of [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], the raid of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. He leads the third wave of the invasion and sprays purple ki volleys at you.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Cui is the boss of wave 3, together with 15 [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]]. He stays dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking him wakes him up early. Like every raid boss, he glows red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid he has 900 health, 45 melee damage and 40 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Smart]] AI tier. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Cui flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Ki Volley:''' a spray of small purple ki blasts.
* '''Dodging:''' he can step back out of the way of your hits.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Cui drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion#Rewards|Frieza's Invasion]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]], the quest '''Cui's Pursuit''' has you defeat him on Namek's Ajissa Plains.
</translate>
